description: This PHP source file defines a Symfony console command class 'ResetInstallationCommand' for resetting an instance of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to configure the command and execute a reset process that drops databases, removes configuration files and keys, and outputs progress messages.

classes.name: ResetInstallationCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command for resetting OrangeHRM installation by dropping databases and removing configuration files and keys.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command with a description 'Reset OrangeHRM installed instance'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the reset process: checks installation, drops databases, removes files, and outputs status messages.
